reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, takes its categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and its sign from the existing averageToBudget.

duplication.why: The template and #fixed exclusions are added once inside the shared selection; no per-action copies.

placement.why: Exclusion rules live in the bulk-selection helper in actions.ts that the tree already uses for this decision, and the new handler is registered next to its siblings in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the bulk selection, the bulk actions, the handler registration and tests change.

maintainability.why: One function owns which categories bulk actions write; minor oddities are the catch-all treating unparsable goal_def as a saved template and an opaque FIXED_TAG regex.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All bulk actions call getBulkBudgetCategories and pass includeHiddenCategories through to its existing includeHidden parameter.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the new action reuses averageToBudget instead of re-deriving the sign.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories keeps its signature; the two new filters apply uniformly to every caller and the existing includeHidden parameter carries the new flag.
